en: A black-and-white image of a grand domed basilica with neoclassical architecture, including large columns, statues on the roofline, and an ornate central dome. There is an old-fashioned street lamp in the foreground and a few scattered trees and people. The surrounding buildings and street indicate a European city setting. The basilica is highly detailed, with a prominent drum and lantern atop the dome.
